How to Make a GIF from a Video and Keep the File Small

Published November 3, 2026 · Ubahin Team

A GIF is a short moving image that is easy to share and plays automatically in many apps. You can make one from your own video, such as a tutorial clip or a funny moment you recorded.

Steps

  1. Open Video to GIF and choose a video (MP4, MOV, or WEBM).
  2. Enter the start time in seconds, for example 12 or 0:12.
  3. Choose the GIF length. The maximum is 20 seconds.
  4. Choose the width and frames per second, then press Create GIF.

Why are GIFs so large?

A GIF stores every frame as a full image and supports only 256 colors. It does not use video compression, so 5 seconds of GIF can be much larger than the same 5 seconds of video.

How to keep the size down

  • Choose a width of 320 px for a GIF you will send over chat.
  • Use 8 to 10 frames per second. The motion still looks natural.
  • Keep the duration as short as possible. 2 to 5 seconds is enough for many purposes.
  • Trim a long video first with Trim Video if needed.

Note

Use videos that you own or have the right to use.
